events.verdict: Portis (MIL) initiates contact with Claxton's (BKN) left arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
The shot clock expires while Milwaukee is still in possession of the ball.
Rollins (MIL) closes out towards Johnson (BKN) and initiates illegal contact that affects his ability to return to the floor.

Clowney (BKN) legally contests Portis' (MIL) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released. The marginal lower body contact is created by Portis extending his leg as part of his shooting motion.
Johnson (BKN) makes contact with Lopez's (MIL) hand on the ball, and therefore is considered the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Simmons (BKN) deflects the pass out of bounds.
Portis (MIL) and Clowney (BKN) come together at the same spot on the floor and Clowney loses his balance.
Wilson (BKN) and Lopez (MIL) pursue the loose ball and the arm to arm contact that occurs is marginal.
Lopez (MIL) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds after it goes off of his foot.

Clowney (BKN) grabs and pulls Portis's (MIL) jersey away from his body as he attempts to defend the pass. Although Portis also grasps Clowney's jersey, he quickly releases it as the pass is thrown and does not prevent him from reaching the pass.
Lopez (MIL) establishes screening position in Simmons' (BKN) path and does not deliver contact during the pick.
Johnson (BKN) legally contests Middleton's (MIL) jump shot attempt.
Middleton (MIL) commits a take foul on Johnson (BKN).

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Middleton (MIL) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
